# Millwright

> Millwright is the practice of Charles Max Wood ("Chuck"): building AI-powered
> applications and AI developer tooling, and writing on the technology
> underneath AI policy and legislation.

<!-- TODO: replace the summary above and the descriptions below once the real
     copy is written. Keep this file short — it is a map, not a brochure. -->

Chuck is a software engineer and consultant based in Utah. He works with
engineering teams implementing AI, and writes about how AI systems actually
behave for audiences that include legislators and legislative staff. He also
serves as Vice Chair of the Utah County Republican Party. Separately, he runs
Top End Devs (https://topenddevs.com/), an independent developer media
business that is not part of Millwright.

## Practices

- [Build](https://millwrightbench.com/build/): AI application development, AI
  developer tooling, and implementation consulting for engineering teams. This
  is the commercial side of the practice.
- [Policy](https://millwrightbench.com/policy/): technical perspective on AI
  and legislation. This is a point of view, not a service offering — Chuck does
  not sell policy advocacy or lobbying from this site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://millwrightbench.com/)

- [Policy](https://millwrightbench.com/policy/)

  https://millwrightbench.com/writing/index.xml
- [Speaking](https://millwrightbench.com/speaking/): talks for developer
  audiences and briefings for civic and legislative audiences.
- [About](https://millwrightbench.com/about/): background and affiliations.
- [Contact](https://millwrightbench.com/contact/)
